answer: A practical defense is giving every agent a public, on-chain ledger that records its steady pulse of completed work. Like a real ocean, where a single inlet cannot fake the whole tide, a sybil swarm cannot fake real history: each agent earns a slowly growing reputation score only from time-stamped contributions attested by diverse peers. New identities start near zero and gain weight gradually, so spinning up ten thousand fake agents yields ten thousand weak voices, not ten thousand votes. Colluding clusters reveal themselves through graph patterns and get quarantined.
